Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner overrode the corroborated finding that Busba Kitiyakara’s paternal grandfather is Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana and instead incorrectly concluded it was Prince Bhanurangsi Savangwongse. This was a logical misstep and title/name conflation, contradicting the Wikipedia source just consulted (which clearly states Kitiyakara Voralaksana is Sirikit’s paternal grandfather, and thus also Busba’s).
